title: Supreme Court: Mays v. Hines
summary: The Sixth Circuit erred in revisiting on federal habeas review the decision of a Tennessee court supported by ample evidence that did not exceed the possibility of fairminded disagreement. (No. 20-507, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 592 U.S. 385).

title: Supreme Court: Ford Motor Co. v. Montana Eighth Judicial Dist.
summary: The connection between plaintiffs’ product-liability claims arising from car accidents occurring in each plaintiff’s State of residence and Ford’s activities in those States is sufficient to support specific jurisdiction in the respective State courts even though the automobiles involved in the accidents were manufactured and sold elsewhere. (No. 19-368, opinion by Justice Kagan; 592 U.S. 351).

title: Supreme Court: Torres v. Madrid
summary: Application of physical force to the body of a person with intent to restrain is a seizure even if the person does not submit and is not subdued. (No. 19-292, opinion by Chief Justice Roberts; 592 U.S. 306).

title: Supreme Court: Uzuegbunam v. Preczewski
summary: A request for nominal damages satisfies the redressability element necessary for Article III standing where a plaintiff’s claim is based on a completed violation of a legal right. (No. 19-968, opinion by Justice Thomas; 592 U.S. 279).

title: Supreme Court: United States Fish and Wildlife Serv. v. Sierra Club, Inc.
summary: The deliberative process privilege protects from disclosure under FOIA in-house draft biological opinions that are both predecisional and deliberative, even if the drafts reflect the agencies’ last views about a proposal. (No. 19-547, opinion by Justice Barrett; 592 U.S. 261).

title: Supreme Court: Pereida v. Wilkinson
summary: A nonpermanent resident seeking to cancel a lawful removal order fails to carry his burden of showing that he has not been convicted of a disqualifying offense when the statutory conviction on his record is ambiguous regarding whether a disqualifying offense formed the basis of his conviction. (No. 19-438, opinion by Justice Gorsuch; 592 U.S. 224).

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Capacity Placard Plate Could Pinch Operator Hand (613 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2017-2020 DT65-H and DT65-E vehicles.  The location of the capacity placard plate could cause a pinch point between the boom and the placard plate.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Lithium-Ion Battery May Short Circuit (4,696 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Kona Electric and 2020 Ioniq Electric vehicles.  The lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery may short-circuit.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Slide-Room May Partially Detach while Moving (261 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 Catalina 184BHS and 184 BHS-W travel trailer recreational vehicles.  The interior plates that clamp the slide-mechanism to the interior wall were installed incorrectly, which may cause the slide-room to partially detach during transit.

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Locking Tabs May Break Off During Operation (257 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2009-2020 Aerial vehicles equipped with a positional waterway trolley.  If the operator attempts to both extend the ladder, and shift from one mode to the other at the same time, the locking tabs can be broken off the locking arms.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Front Passenger Seat Occupancy Sensor Mat May Fail (39,547 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Macan, Macan Turbo Kits, Macan GTS, 2015-2018 Macan S, and Macan Turbo vehicles.  The front passenger seat occupancy sensor mat may degrade and fail to detect a passenger in the front seat.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Incorrectly Machined Wheel Lug Bolt Holes (128 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021 Atlas and Atlas Cross Sport vehicles.  The lug bolt holes on the wheels may have been machined incorrectly, preventing the wheel bolt from sufficiently attaching to the wheel bearing hub.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Flexible Section Of Exhaust System May Separate (355 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2017-2019 DC1317 and DRM12 Chippers equipped with a gasoline engine.  The flexible section of the exhaust pipe may separate, creating an exhaust gas leak.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Brake Lights May Not Illuminate (807,376 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2016-2019 Nissan Sentra vehicles.  The brake light switch may become contaminated, preventing the circuit from closing and the brake lights from illuminating.

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Steering Gear Fasteners May Become Loose (10 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Inferno vehicles.  The steering gear mounting bolts may become loose and back out, resulting in difficulty steering.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Engine Compartment Fire (379,931 affected)
summary: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2017-2021 Sportage and Cadenza vehicles.  The electrical circuit in the Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit (HECU) may short-circuit, which can cause a fire in the engine compartment.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Tie Rod Ball Joint Fastener Not Tightened Properly (2,407 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Nissan Altima vehicles.  The tie rod ball joint fastener was not tightened properly, which could result in the tie rod ball joint detaching from the steering knuckle.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Front Passenger Air Bag Cushion May Tear (26,158 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (INFINITI) is recalling certain 2003 INFINITI FX35, 2006-2008 FX35 and FX45 vehicles that previously received a replacement front passenger air bag assembly under recall number 20V-008.  The air bag cushion was folded incorrectly, which could increase internal pressure and tear the air bag cushion during deployment.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loose Subframe Bolts (1,258 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 Mustang Mach-E vehicles.  The front subframe bolts may not have been tightened properly during assembly, which could result in loose bolts.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Possible Furnace Exhaust Leak into Living Space (21 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 Cardinal CAF345RLX, CAF366DVLE, CAF390FBX and 2021 Wildcat WCF336RLS, WCF368MB vehicles.  The furnace flue may become misaligned due to insufficient furnace hold screws that allow movement during travel.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Tire Failure may Cause Sudden Air Loss (2,535 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Atlas vehicles equipped with Continental tires.  On the affected vehicles, it is possible that one or more tires were cured for too long during tire production.

title: Custom Truck And Body Works: Rear LED Lights Too Bright/FMVSS 108 (2 affected)
summary: Custom Truck And Body Works (Custom Truck) is recalling one 2016 Ford F550 vehicle and one 2018 International 4000 vehicle equipped with 7x9 combination LED Stop-Tail-Turn reverse lights.  The lights may be too bright, exceeding the maximum light output allowed which may adversely affect the vision of drivers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: Lower Control Arm May Detach Due to Corrosion (15,347 affected)
summary: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc. (MMNA) is recalling certain 2013-2015 Outlander Sport vehicles originally sold, or ever registered, in Connecticut, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, and Wisconsin.  The front lower control arms may detach due to the front cross member corroding from salt water exposure, such as from road salt use.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Spare Tire Carrier Incorrectly Installed (309 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 Cardinal and Wildcat Fifth Wheels trailers.  The spare tire carrier may be installed incorrectly, allowing it to detach from the vehicle.

title: Combi USA, Inc.: Child Seat Webbing May Fail/FMVSS 213 (13,880 affected)
summary: Combi USA, Inc. (Combi) is recalling certain Combi BabyRide Infant Car Seats, model 378099 with dates of manufacture of 5/1/2016 thru 8/31/2019. The 1-inch-wide webbing strap used in the center front adjuster to adjust the shoulder harness straps fail the minimum initial breaking strength requirements, and in certain circumstances, may not adequately restrain a child during a crash.  As such, these car seats fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Hino Motors Sales U.S.A., Inc.: Mirror Glass May Detach From Carrier Plate (4,848 affected)
summary: Hino Motors Sales U.S.A., Inc. (Hino) is recalling certain 2020 NE8J, NJ8J,  NV8J, NH1A, NV1A and TH1A vehicles.  The mirror glass may not be bonded properly to the carrier plate, allowing it to detach.

title: MEKRA Lang North America, LLC: Mirror Glass May Detach From Carrier Plate (4,532 affected)
summary: MEKRA Lang North America, LLC. (MEKRA) is recalling certain Main Mirror Housings, part numbers 154270012 and 154270010.  The mirror glass may not be bonded properly to the carrier plate, allowing it to detach.

title: WP Dynamics: ReadyLift Lift Kit Bolts May Break (1,844 affected)
summary: WP Dynamics (ReadyLIFT) is recalling certain ReadyLIFT Lift Kits designed to fit certain 2019-2021 Dodge Ram 1500, 2015-2020 Ford F-150, 2005-2016 Ford Super Duty, and 2017-2021 Ford F-250 and F-350 pickup trucks (please see the Part 573 report for lift kit part numbers).  Certain bolts within the Lift Kits may not have been heat-treated properly, which can allow them to break.  Broken bolts may cause separation of the suspension lower control arm, radius arm, relocation bracket, or the crossmember from the frame or chassis.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Internal Damage to ABS Module (4 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Ram ProMaster City vehicles.  The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) module may have internal damage, which could result in a loss of braking performance or autonomous braking functions.

title: Shyft Group: Flexible Exhaust Tube May Tear (34 affected)
summary: Shyft Group is recalling certain 2017-2019 Utilimaster Mobile Maintenance Trucks equipped with a generator set.  The flexible exhaust tube may tear, releasing hot exhaust gases into the generator compartment.

title: Autocar, LLC: Steering Shaft May Bind (60 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Legend vehicles.  The steering column tilt control cable may contact the steering shaft, possibly causing the steering shaft to bind and requiring an increased effort to steer the vehicle.

title: Autocar, LLC: Loss of Headlight and Wiper Function/FMVSS 108/104 (24 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2020 Legend vehicles.  The headlight and windshield wiper wiring harness may become disconnected during operation.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment", and 104, "Windshield Wiping and Washing Systems."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Brake Lights and Tail Lights Too High/FMVSS 108 (123 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (Nova) is recalling certain 2008-2021 LFS Buses.  The center-line height of the brake lights and tail lights is too high, exceeding the maximum height standard.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Brake Pedal Bolt Could Come Loose (56,534 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Freightliner Sprinter vehicles.  The retaining washer and bolt that connect the brake pedal to the bearing block, may come loose and detach.  This could cause the brake lights to stay illuminated, even when the brake pedal is not pressed.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Incorrect Lock for Electric Sliding Door/FMVSS 226 (56 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Mercedes Benz Sprinter vehicles equipped with an optional electric sliding door.  The auxiliary lock on the sliding door may be the incorrect type for an electric sliding door.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Lower Control Arm Bolts May Break (49 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020 Lincoln Aviator and Ford Explorer vehicles.  The rear lower control arm (RLCA) bolts that attach the rear lower control arms to the wheel knuckles may not have been heat-treated, which could cause them to break.

title: Ford Motor Company: Tire Failure may Cause Sudden Air Loss (15,769 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2018 F-150, 2018-2020 F-250, F-350, and 2019 Escape vehicles equipped with Continental tires.  On the affected vehicles, it is possible that one or more tires were cured for too long during tire production.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Head Restraints Incorrect (258 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2021 X5 sDrive40i, X5 xDrive50i, X5 M50i, X5 xDrive45e, 2021 X7 xDrive40i, X7 M50i, and XB7 vehicles.  The head restraints on the second-row outer seats may be the incorrect type for the vehicle.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Suspension Components Not Tightened Properly (396 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2021 Porsche Taycan Turbo, Taycan Turbo S, Taycan, Taycan 4S, 911 Turbo S Coupe, Cayman, Cayman T, Cayman S, Cayman GT4, 911 Carrera Coupe, 911 Carrera S Coupe, 911 Carrera 4S Coupe, 911 Carrera 4S Targa, 911 Carrera Cabriolet, 911 Carrera S Cabriolet, 911 Carrera 4S Targa Heritage Design Edition, 911 Carrera 4S Cabriolet, 911 Turbo Coupe, 911 Turbo Cabriolet, 911 Turbo S Cabriolet, 718 Spyder, and Boxster vehicles.  Certain suspension components may not have been tightened correctly and can loosen.

title: Safety Belt Solutions Ltd: Seat Belt Part Incorrectly Heat-Treated/FMVSS 209 (3,000 affected)
summary: Safety Belt Solutions Ltd. (Safety Belt Solutions) is recalling certain seat belts with part number 202441-1/MFG 35FB9.  The seat belt tongues may not have been heat-treated correctly during manufacturing.  As such, these seat belts fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver's Air Bag Inflator May Explode (2,602,668 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2007-2011 Ranger, 2006-2012 Fusion, Lincoln Zephyr, Lincoln MKZ, 2006-2011 Mercury Milan, 2007-2010 Ford Edge, and Lincoln MKX vehicles.  The driver's side air bag inflator may explode due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, high temperatures, and high temperature cycling.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Passenger Air Bag May Deploy Incorrectly (3,421 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2021 Audi RS6 Avant, RS7, 2020-2021 A6 Allroad, S6 Sedan, S7, 2019-2021 A6 Sedan, and A7 vehicles.  The score line on the passenger air bag may not have been manufactured correctly.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Anti-Lock Brake System Module May Short Circuit (94,646 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Genesis and 2017-2020 Genesis G80 vehicles.   The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) module could malfunction and short circuit.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Anti-Lock Brake System Module May Short Circuit (552 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Genesis G70 vehicles.  The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) module could malfunction and short circuit.

title: Mazda North American Operations: Driver's Air Bag Inflator May Explode (5,847 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2007-2009 B-Series pickup trucks.  The driver's side air bag inflator may explode due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, high temperatures, and high temperature cycling.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Relay May Short and Cause Fire (19,214 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Ram 2500, 3500, and 3500, 4500, and 5500 Cab Chassis vehicles equipped with a Cummins 6.7L Turbo Diesel engine.  An electrical short may occur in the Solid State Intake Heater Grid Relay, which could result in a vehicle fire.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Occupant Detection System Malfunction/FMVSS 208 (142 affected)
summary: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2021 Telluride, K5, and Forte vehicles. The Occupant Classification and Detection System (OCS/ODS) unit may not detect the presence of a child restraint system in the front passenger seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Tire Failure may Cause Sudden Air Loss (1,093 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Passport and Pilot vehicles equipped with Continental tires.  On the affected vehicles, it is possible that one or more tires were cured for too long during tire production.

title: Battle Motors, Inc.: Brake Light Pressure Switch Malfunction (298 affected)
summary: Crane Carrier Company (Crane Carrier) is recalling certain 2020-2021 LET2 vehicles equipped with certain SL-4 Brake Light Pressure switches.  When air pressure is supplied to the brake light switch it may leak, possibly causing the internal electrical contacts to become jammed.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: ABS and DSC Systems May Become Disabled (2,089 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2020 Jaguar F-Type vehicles.  The diagnostic check for the Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) that runs at vehicle startup may not complete in the time required, which could disable the ABS and the Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) system during that drive cycle.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Lower Knee Air Bag Cushion Cover May Come Loose (250 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2020 Range Rover Evoque vehicles.  The cushion cover on the left-side lower knee air bag may come loose, which could result in the cushion unfolding from the air bag module housing.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Tire Failure may Cause Sudden Air Loss (36,141 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Altima and 2018-2021 Titan vehicles equipped with Continental tires.  On the affected vehicles, it is possible that one or more tires were cured for too long during tire production.

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls YTL Log Splitters with Briggs & Stratton Engines Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An incorrect engine ignition coil and flywheel can lead to hard starting and engine kick back, posing an injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 9,750 (In addition, 290 were sold in Canada).

title: Genentech Recalls Prescription Drug Evrysdi Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Drug Exposure through Eye or Skin Absorption (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottles containing the prescription drug can leak due to a fit issue between the press-in bottle adapter and bottleneck. title: HD Hudson Recalls Battery-Powered Sprayers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sprayer's lithium-ion battery can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 64,000.

title: Parker Squared Recalls Shepherd Boy Plush Toys with Wire Shepherd's Staff Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The metal wire in the shepherd's staff can become exposed, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 3,000 (In addition, about 10 were sold in Canada).

title: Global Home Imports Recalls Platform Bed Frames Due to Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The HR platform frame can collapse, posing a crush hazard that can result in severe injury or death. Units: About 82,000.

title: HOFISH Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.
